release.title: Your tasks, even offline
release.subtitle: Work offline. Sync when you reconnect.

hero.title: No connection? Keep going.
hero.body: Create and edit tasks offline. Your changes stay saved, even when you close the app.

features.title: Kanban, even offline
features.body: Create tasks and move them on downloaded project boards.

features.title: Sync at a glance
features.body: See pending changes and failure reasons in Settings.

features.title: Tap to check off
features.body: Check off items directly in task descriptions.

features.title: Your calendar, offline
features.body: Open downloaded tasks and jump back to today with a tap.

fixes: Widgets can use downloaded tasks when your server is unavailable.
Quick add matches names more accurately and keeps new labels selected.
Deleted subprojects stay deleted. Rapid task completions are preserved.
Kanban loads all tasks and handles column limits during sync.
Sync recovery lets you discard all unsynced account changes and reload from your server.

offline-mode.title: Keep working offline
offline-mode.intro: No setup needed. Just load your data before going offline.

steps.title: Load your data
steps.body: Open your projects, tasks, and boards while connected. Only downloaded data is available offline.

steps.title: Keep working
steps.body: Create, edit, and complete tasks. Your changes stay saved on this device.

steps.title: Reconnect
steps.body: Viku tries to sync automatically. Check Settings → Pending Sync if anything is still waiting.

offline-mode.tip: Attachments and saved-filter boards need a connection. Refresh saved-filter lists after syncing. Keep the app installed until all changes have synced.

items: Rename and delete saved filters, and view their queries.
Clearer menus for special project lists.
Faster project counts and account names, plus better two-factor sign-in focus.
